sources: corrected provenance store (is_current); defense/anim/data artifacts; collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor; simulation/*.py; g6_runs/*.stats.json

findings.quote: TTFT p99 of 398~ms at $1\times$ the trace rate against the 8B's 307~ms
findings.checked_against: llm_run_summary g3_32b:235b_tp8_s1 (is_current) p99_ttft_ms = 387.37; point artifact defense/anim/data/g3_32b/points/235b_tp8_s1.json ttft_ms.p99 = 387.368; wheelcheck variant = 392.70. No artifact yields 398.
findings.evidence: 235B-A22B TP8 at s=1 has TTFT p99 = 387 ms, not 398. The 8B's 307 ms is correct (307.36). 398 appears in no current or archived run.
findings.proposed_fix: TTFT p99 of 387~ms at $1\times$ the trace rate against the 8B's 307~ms

findings.quote: the flagship's ITL p99 is already \SI{87.7}{\milli\second} at the trace's own rate
findings.checked_against: llm_run_summary g3_32b:235b_tp8_s1 (is_current) p99_itl_ms = 86.151; point artifact itl_ms.p99 = 86.151; wheelcheck = 88.85. None equal 87.7.
findings.evidence: 235B ITL p99 at s=1 is 86.2 ms, not 87.7 ms. The load-bearing conclusion (just under the 100 ms bound, so the knee sits at s=1) is unaffected: 86.2 < 100.
findings.proposed_fix: the flagship's ITL p99 is already \SI{86.2}{\milli\second} at the trace's own rate

findings.quote: with $2\times$ the decode latency throughout (TPOT 14.9 vs.\ 7.9~ms; 87 vs.\ 142 output tok/s per user)
findings.evidence: Per-user tok/s 87 vs 142 is exact. TPOT is 14.7 vs 7.8 ms (rounds), not 14.9 vs 7.9; the '~2x decode latency' ratio (14.70/7.76 = 1.89) still holds.
findings.proposed_fix: with roughly $2\times$ the decode latency throughout (TPOT 14.7 vs.\ 7.8~ms; 87 vs.\ 142 output tok/s per user)

findings.quote: the two tails are positively correlated ($r{=}0.53$ on image-bearing requests)
findings.checked_against: requires per-request join of encoder delay and prefill TTFT on the aggregate composed run (a12); the store keeps stage summaries and per-request token rows but not a joined encoder-delay+TTFT per-request table that is cheaply queryable. Prior extraction listed r=0.52; tex now 0.53 (edited).
findings.evidence: The sign/magnitude claim (positive, moderate correlation driving the near-sum composition) is consistent with e2e_p99 1240 coinciding with the naive marginal sum, but the exact r could not be recomputed within budget.

findings.quote: under the sequential alternative ... delay p99 plateaus at \SI{2.9}{\second} from 4 through 32 workers
findings.checked_against: encoder_run_summary.chunk_dispatch has only 'parallel' (1115) and NULL (2); no sequential/chained-dispatch sweep row in the store, and no matching report located in defense/anim/data or simulation/results within budget.
findings.evidence: The chunk-parallel-vs-sequential contrast is a stated converter-flag sensitivity; the parallel side is fully verified but the sequential 2.9 s plateau (4-32 workers, fastest-onset episode) has no located artifact.

findings.quote: requests beyond the \texttt{h100\_sxm} grid's \num{16384}-token edge (${\approx}3.1\%$ of the trace, up to ${\approx}149$k tokens ...) are priced by extrapolation
findings.checked_against: eda_metric holds ctx multi-resolution maxima (1s max 347807 tok/s aggregate, single-request max not exposed) but no stored fraction(ContextTokens>16384) or max-per-request = 149k; deferred to Section aic-composition.
findings.evidence: Large-context tail exists (burst-window max input_length = 121188 tokens per sweeps:vision_burst1_s1 metrics), consistent with the direction, but the exact 3.1% / 149k could not be reproduced from available tables.

findings.checked_against: collector_encoder_fn.ratio_meas_over_aic is NULL for image_px=896 (aic_pred_ms only populated to N=128 at 448); 896 rows exist only for engine='vllm' (vllm_multires.json, 8 rows). The 1.14x eager-vs-serving ratio at 896 was not located as a stored scalar.
findings.evidence: The 448 band 1.36-1.62x ('~1.4-1.6x') is CONFIRMED via ratio_meas_over_aic; the 896^2 1.14x figure (Appendix engine-sensitivity) has no readily queryable source.
